findings.reason: Cooked food in stainless steel bowls is covered with lids or plates; fresh vegetables and fruits are placed separately on lower shelves, with no raw meat stored above ready-to-eat items.
Sink basin is clean, running water is demonstrated from the tap, and liquid soap is present on the rack above the sink.
Waste bin is fitted with an intact lid that is kept closed, and there is no evidence of overflow.
While the gas stove and stone countertops are wiped clean, the wooden cutting board exhibits noticeable dark staining and water damage on its surface.
Ingredients and spices are stored off the floor on a multi-tier countertop rack inside closed plastic containers with lids.

liveness.observed: A hand held out three extended fingers resting on the surface of the gas stove.

continuousTake.detail: The recording is a single continuous take without cuts, edits, or frame freezing.

sameKitchenAsReference.detail: The kitchen layout, patterned wall tiles, stocked refrigerator, sink, spice racks, microwave, and two-burner stove align with the reference description.

activityMatchesOrders.detail: The kitchen demonstrates active meal prep with a pressure cooker on the stove, a cutting board with knife ready, and fresh produce stocked, consistent with a low order volume of 6 orders in the last hour.

propsSuspected.detail: Supplies, produce, containers, and appliances display typical everyday domestic and cloud kitchen use without signs of artificial staging.

integrity.kitchenSummary: A domestic cloud kitchen featuring a stocked refrigerator with fresh vegetables, a sink station, a covered trash container, a two-burner Prestige gas stove holding a pressure cooker, an adjacent countertop with a cutting board, mixer, microwave, and tiered spice racks.

en: Deep clean the wooden cutting board using hot soapy water and sanitize it with coarse salt and lemon juice or food-safe disinfectant.
Smooth out stained or moisture-damaged patches on the board by sanding, or replace it with a new food-grade cutting board if cracks remain.
Always dry the cutting board completely in an upright, well-ventilated spot after washing to prevent water damage and dark spots.
Great effort on keeping the gas stove and stone countertops clean and spotless—keep up this high standard!
In the next review, please share close-up, well-lit photos of all food-prep boards and surrounding prep tables to verify them easily.
hi: लकड़ी के चॉपिंग बोर्ड को गर्म साबुन के पानी से गहराई से साफ करें और मोटे नमक व नींबू या सुरक्षित कीटाणुनाशक से सैनिटाइज करें।
बोर्ड पर लगे गहरे दाग या पानी के निशानों को हल्का घिसकर हटाएं, या जरूरत हो तो नया फूड-ग्रेड कटिंग बोर्ड इस्तेमाल करें।
धोने के बाद बोर्ड को हमेशा हवादार जगह पर खड़ा करके पूरी तरह सुखाएं ताकि नमी और काले धब्बे न पनपें।
गैस चूल्हा और पत्थर के काउंटरटॉप को एकदम साफ रखने के लिए आपकी मेहनत सराहनीय है, इसे ऐसे ही बनाए रखें!
अगली जांच में कटिंग बोर्ड और तैयारी वाले सभी टेबल की अच्छी रोशनी में साफ तस्वीरें साझा करें ताकि सब स्पष्ट दिखाई दे सके।
or: କାଠ କଟିଂ ବୋର୍ଡକୁ ଉଷୁମ ସାବୁନ ପାଣିରେ ଭଲ ଭାବେ ଧୋଇ ଲୁଣ ଓ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ କିମ୍ବା ଖାଦ୍ୟ-ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ଡିସଇନଫେକ୍ଟାଣ୍ଟ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଜୀବାଣୁମୁକ୍ତ କରନ୍ତୁ।
ଦାଗ ଲାଗିଥିବା ବା ପାଣିରେ ନଷ୍ଟ ହୋଇଥିବା ଅଂଶକୁ ସଫା କରନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ହେଲେ ନୂଆ ଫୁଡ୍-ଗ୍ରେଡ୍ ବୋର୍ଡ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
ଧୋଇବା ପରେ ବୋର୍ଡକୁ ସର୍ବଦା ପବନ ଚଳାଚଳ ହେଉଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଛିଡ଼ା କରି ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ଶୁଖାନ୍ତୁ, ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ପାଣି ଜମି କଳା ଦାଗ ହେବ ନାହିଁ।
ଗ୍ୟାସ ଚୁଲା ଏବଂ କାଉଣ୍ଟରଟପ୍ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସଫାସୁତୁରା ରଖିଥିବାରୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପରିଶ୍ରମ ପ୍ରଶଂସନୀୟ, ଏହା ଜାରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ!
ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ସମୟରେ ସମସ୍ତ କଟିଂ ବୋର୍ଡ ଏବଂ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ସ୍ଥାନର ଭଲ ଆଲୋକରେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଫଟୋ ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ।
